fees.intro: Success and co-broke fees per deal at the price-plan version in force on the closing day. One invoice per agency per month (the monthly cap as a discount line), never deducted from rent. This month's fees wait for next month's invoice.
fees.emptyHint: A fee accrues when an agency's deal closes and a price is published.
fees.disputeBody: Requests a credit note on invoice {invoice} for what this fee was charged incl. VAT (fee {amount} before VAT), never above the unpaid part. Another platform user approves it on the invoice.
fees.disputed: Credit note requested — awaiting a second approver
fees.reasonHint: Kept on the credit note and in the audit trail

media.intro: Verified photo and 360° orders of every tenant. Once paid, book the partner photographer, upload the files as documents of the unit, then deliver.
media.emptyHint: New orders appear here when an owner orders from a listing's page.

next.pending_payment: Waiting for the owner to pay the invoice
next.delivered: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} delivered

media.waitPayment: Not paid yet — the visit can be booked once the invoice is paid.
media.visitHint: When the photographer enters the room and the partner's reference. The visit can move until the files are delivered.
media.partnerRefHint: The job number in the photographer's system, if any
media.deliverIntro: Each file becomes a document of the unit in the ordering tenant and counts towards its storage. Images become listing photos, anything else a general document.
media.filesHint: JPG, PNG, WebP, PDF or MP4 — up to 60 files
media.deliverHint: The owner sees the files in the unit's documents and can add them to the listing.
media.deliveredTitle: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} delivered
media.cancelTitle: Cancel the order for unit {unit} of {tenant}
media.cancelBodyUnpaid: The unpaid order is cancelled; Finance voids its invoice.
media.cancelBodyPaid: The owner has paid. Money comes back only through a credit note Finance requests — nothing is refunded from here.
